steps.name: verify_booking
steps.instruction: Look up the booking and confirm its status, fare class, refundability, purchase timing, departure timing, and whether travel has already been completed.

steps.name: gather_cancellation_intent
steps.instruction: Confirm with the customer that they cancelled the booking themselves and the amount they paid.

steps.name: check_fare_rules
steps.instruction: Evaluate the fare rules: refundable fares and unused tickets inside the 24-hour window are refunded to original payment; Saver fares depend on days before departure; non-refundable Main, Premium, Business and First fares may receive future travel credit with no credit for unused flight value beyond that.

steps.name: decide_ruling
steps.instruction: Issue the deterministic ruling: full refund to original payment, partial travel credit, or denial, based on the fare rule checks.

steps.name: authorize_remedy
steps.instruction: Authorize the refund or travel credit amount before execution, confirming the ticket has not been surrendered beyond the 12-month limit.

steps.name: execute_remedy
steps.instruction: Issue the authorized refund to the original form of payment or the authorized travel credit, and draft the customer reply explaining the ruling.

steps.name: Close-out (placeholder)
steps.instruction: After the customer is resolved: disposition of the item (restock / open-box / return to vendor / carrier claim) for retail; recovery within policy for airlines. Designed, not implemented, in the POC.

outcomes.remedy: Refund to original form of payment
outcomes.condition: Booking cancelled within 24 hours of purchase, whole, unused, and nonrefundable

outcomes.remedy: Refund to original form of payment
outcomes.condition: Refundable fare, unused, surrendered within 12 months of issue

outcomes.remedy: Travel credit for 50% of ticket value and 100% of taxes
outcomes.condition: Saver fare cancelled 14 or more days before outbound departure

outcomes.remedy: No refund or credit; full ticket value forfeited
outcomes.condition: Saver fare cancelled 13 or fewer days before outbound departure

outcomes.remedy: Travel credit for future flights; no credit for the unused flight value itself
outcomes.condition: Non-refundable Main, Premium, Business or First fare cancelled for future travel

steps.name: Verify booking
steps.instruction: Look up the booking and confirm the passenger checked a bag on the flight in question.

steps.name: Gather claim timing and bag arrival
steps.instruction: Ask the customer when the bag guarantee claim was filed and how many minutes passed before the bag reached the carousel after the flight arrived at the gate.

steps.name: Check flight status and route
steps.instruction: Confirm the flight's origin, destination and whether it is domestic, to establish whether the guarantee applies.

steps.name: Check flight eligibility and delay threshold
steps.instruction: Confirm the flight is operated by an eligible carrier and flight number range, is not to or from Dutch Harbor, and does not require customs clearance. Confirm bags were not at baggage claim within 20 minutes of gate arrival.

steps.name: Decide bag guarantee eligibility
steps.instruction: If the flight is eligible and the bag arrived more than 20 minutes after gate arrival, approve the 20-minute bag guarantee offer as a voucher or bonus points. Otherwise deny the request. Carry-on items are excluded unless Alaska was at fault.

steps.name: Issue bag guarantee remedy
steps.instruction: After authorization, issue the $25 discount code or 2,500 Atmos Rewards bonus points for an approved claim.

steps.name: Close-out (placeholder)
steps.instruction: After the customer is resolved: disposition of the item (restock / open-box / return to vendor / carrier claim) for retail; recovery within policy for airlines. Designed, not implemented, in the POC.

outcomes.remedy: Issue $25 discount code or 2,500 Atmos Rewards bonus points (voucher)
outcomes.condition: Bag checked, flight eligible, bag not at carousel within 20 minutes of gate arrival

outcomes.remedy: No compensation; explain eligibility limits
outcomes.condition: Flight not eligible (international requiring customs, Dutch Harbor, or outside flight number ranges)

outcomes.remedy: No compensation; explain 20-minute threshold was not exceeded
outcomes.condition: Bag arrived within 20 minutes of gate arrival

outcomes.remedy: No compensation; carry-on remains passenger responsibility
outcomes.condition: Carry-on item claimed as damaged, lost or delayed without Alaska fault

steps.name: Verify booking and bag record
steps.instruction: Confirm the booking and that the checked bag was tagged and is recorded as delayed; pull the bag status and delay duration from merchant data.

steps.name: Check flight status
steps.instruction: Confirm the flight and baggage routing details relevant to the delay so the carrier of record is identified.

steps.name: Gather report and expense facts
steps.instruction: Ask the customer whether a Mishandled Baggage Report was filed, the damage type if any, any bag fee paid, and essentials purchased while waiting with receipts.

steps.name: Check baggage liability and fee refund policy
steps.instruction: Determine whether the bag was delayed or damaged so liability applies; a bag that is undamaged and not delayed is not covered. Confirm an MBR was filed before any bag fee refund.

steps.name: Decide ruling
steps.instruction: Rule on reimbursement of documented reasonable interim expenses for substantial delay and on refund of the bag fee where the MBR requirement is met. Deny if the bag was not delayed or damaged or the carrier is not at fault for carry-on items.

steps.name: Authorize and execute remedy
steps.instruction: After authorization, issue the bag fee refund and/or reimburse documented expenses per the ruling; escalate to a supervisor when the ruling is outside standard limits.

steps.name: Close-out (placeholder)
steps.instruction: After the customer is resolved: disposition of the item (restock / open-box / return to vendor / carrier claim) for retail; recovery within policy for airlines. Designed, not implemented, in the POC.

outcomes.remedy: No compensation; explain that liability does not attach to undamaged, non-delayed checked bags.
outcomes.condition: Bag not damaged, not delayed, or not lost

outcomes.remedy: Reimburse documented reasonable essentials expenses as direct result of delay.
outcomes.condition: Bag significantly delayed, documented reasonable interim expenses, reasonable effort shown

outcomes.remedy: Refund the bag fee paid for the delayed bag.
outcomes.condition: Bag significantly delayed and Mishandled Baggage Report filed

outcomes.remedy: Bag fee refund withheld until MBR is filed; request report filing.
outcomes.condition: Bag significantly delayed but no Mishandled Baggage Report filed

outcomes.remedy: Reimburse only the documented reasonable portion; decline carry-on items not attributable to carrier fault.
outcomes.condition: Expense claim exceeds reasonable or documented amount, or item is carry-on not caused by carrier fault

steps.name: Verify booking
steps.instruction: Look up the booking and confirm the fare type and amount paid before evaluating the claim.

steps.name: Check flight status
steps.instruction: Pull the flight record to establish whether the flight was cancelled or delayed, the delay length, the stated cause, and whether the change was significant or required an overnight stay.

steps.name: Confirm cause and customer choice
steps.instruction: Ask the customer what remedy they want and whether they accepted any alternative flight, rebooking, voucher or surface transport. Confirm the cause of the delay or cancellation if the record is unclear.

steps.name: Check applicable policy
steps.instruction: Retrieve the governing clauses for the flight status and customer choice, and confirm which refund, meal and hotel provisions apply.

steps.name: Decide ruling
steps.instruction: Apply the clauses to the verified facts. Refund airfare on cancellation without an offered alternative or on rejection of a significant change. Reimburse meals after three hours of delay and hotel costs for an overnight stay 100 or more miles from home when the cause is within carrier control. Deny when alternative surface transport was accepted or no clause applies.

steps.name: Execute remedy
steps.instruction: After authorization, issue the airfare refund or expense reimbursement that the ruling specifies and notify the customer of the outcome.

steps.name: Close-out (placeholder)
steps.instruction: After the customer is resolved: disposition of the item (restock / open-box / return to vendor / carrier claim) for retail; recovery within policy for airlines. Designed, not implemented, in the POC.

outcomes.remedy: refund
outcomes.condition: Flight cancelled by airline and no alternative flight, voucher or compensation offered

outcomes.remedy: refund
outcomes.condition: Significantly delayed or changed flight rejected by customer, including rebooking or compensation declined

outcomes.remedy: expense_reimbursement
outcomes.condition: Delay of 3 or more hours within carrier control with overnight stay 100+ miles from home and hotels available

outcomes.remedy: expense_reimbursement
outcomes.condition: Delay extends beyond 3 hours and customer is at the airport

outcomes.remedy: none
outcomes.condition: Alternative surface transportation provided and acceptable to the passenger

outcomes.remedy: none
outcomes.condition: No governing clause applies to the delay, cause or customer request

steps.name: Verify booking and bag status
steps.instruction: Look up the booking and confirm the bag was checked on this itinerary and its current status.

steps.name: Collect damage report
steps.instruction: If no damage report has been filed, ask the customer to file a report and describe the damage type (zipper, shell crack, handle).

steps.name: Review damage photos
steps.instruction: Review submitted photos to confirm the bag is damaged and identify the damage type.

steps.name: Capture requested amount
steps.instruction: Record the customer's requested repair or replacement amount with supporting documentation.

steps.name: Check policy eligibility
steps.instruction: Evaluate whether the bag was damaged, whether the damage is excluded as normal wear, manufacturing defect, protruding part, or carry-on, and whether it qualifies for documented damages compensation.

steps.name: Issue ruling
steps.instruction: Apply the deterministic ruling: deny when the bag is undamaged or damage falls under an exclusion; approve documented reasonable damages when covered.

steps.name: Execute remedy if approved
steps.instruction: If approved, authorize and issue the reimbursement for documented reasonable damages up to the liability limit; otherwise communicate the denial.

steps.name: Close-out (placeholder)
steps.instruction: After the customer is resolved: disposition of the item (restock / open-box / return to vendor / carrier claim) for retail; recovery within policy for airlines. Designed, not implemented, in the POC.

outcomes.remedy: none; explain ordinary standard of care
outcomes.condition: Damage is incidental scuff, dent, scratch or normal wear

outcomes.remedy: none; explain protruding-parts exclusion
outcomes.condition: Damage to protruding exterior part such as zipper, handle or wheel from inherent handling

outcomes.remedy: reimburse documented repair or replacement cost up to limit or declared value
outcomes.condition: Documented reasonable damage caused by airline handling within liability limit

outcomes.remedy: voucher or partial reimbursement for documented amount
outcomes.condition: Damage covered but documentation partial or reasonable amount below request

steps.name: Verify booking and seat fee
steps.instruction: Look up the booking and confirm the seat selection or upgrade fee charged to the customer.

steps.name: Gather cause of seat change
steps.instruction: Ask the customer how they were moved from the paid seat or whether they were reassigned at the gate, and record the details.

steps.name: Check automatic refund eligibility
steps.instruction: Evaluate whether the paid seat service was not provided and whether the failure was through no fault of the consumer, and whether the carrier is merchant of record.

steps.name: Decide ruling
steps.instruction: If the paid seat was not provided through no fault of the consumer, rule for a full refund of the seat fee; otherwise deny the request and state the reason.

steps.name: Authorize and execute remedy
steps.instruction: After authorization, issue the refund of the seat fee to the original payment method, or a travel credit where the customer has elected it.

steps.name: Draft customer reply
steps.instruction: Draft a reply confirming the refund or travel credit, or explaining the denial with the reason.

steps.name: Close-out (placeholder)
steps.instruction: After the customer is resolved: disposition of the item (restock / open-box / return to vendor / carrier claim) for retail; recovery within policy for airlines. Designed, not implemented, in the POC.

outcomes.remedy: Automatic refund of the seat fee to the original payment method
outcomes.condition: Paid seat not provided through no fault of consumer and carrier is merchant of record

outcomes.remedy: Travel credit equal to the seat fee
outcomes.condition: Customer elects travel credit in lieu of refund

outcomes.remedy: No refund; explain reason to customer
outcomes.condition: Seat change caused by consumer or service was provided

steps.name: collect_flight_details
steps.instruction: Ask the customer for the flight booking reference, flight numbers and travel date, and the loyalty account number, and note whether the flight was operated by a partner or booked as an Atmos Rewards award.

steps.name: verify_booking
steps.instruction: Look up the booking and confirm the flight was flown, the passenger matches the loyalty account, and the flight is eligible for points (own-operated or partner, not a cancelled or no-show segment).

steps.name: check_points_eligibility
steps.instruction: Evaluate whether the verified flight earns points under the loyalty programme rules for the operating carrier or Atmos Rewards partner, and whether the points were already credited.

steps.name: supervisor_review
steps.instruction: Where the flight is eligible but the points are not on the account, escalate to a supervisor for approval before crediting. Record the supervisor decision.

steps.name: award_missing_points
steps.instruction: After approval, credit the missing points to the loyalty account for the verified flight and confirm the new balance.

steps.name: Close-out (placeholder)
steps.instruction: After the customer is resolved: disposition of the item (restock / open-box / return to vendor / carrier claim) for retail; recovery within policy for airlines. Designed, not implemented, in the POC.

outcomes.remedy: Award the missing points to the loyalty account
outcomes.condition: Flight verified as eligible and points missing from account

outcomes.remedy: Escalate to supervisor before awarding points
outcomes.condition: Flight verified but eligibility or supervisor approval is unclear

outcomes.remedy: Explain the eligibility rule to the customer and make no award
outcomes.condition: Flight not eligible for points or booking not verified

steps.name: verify_booking
steps.instruction: Look up the booking and confirm status, fare class, refundability, payment total, purchase timing and whether travel was completed.

steps.name: check_flight_status
steps.instruction: Verify the flight cause, whether the airline cancelled it, delay length, significant change status, and overnight requirement.

steps.name: gather_cause_and_remedy
steps.instruction: Ask the customer to confirm the cause of disruption and the remedy they want (refund or alternative), and whether they accepted any alternative or voucher.

steps.name: check_refund_eligibility
steps.instruction: Determine refund eligibility: refund is due for a cancelled or significantly delayed/changed flight the customer declines, including automatic refund when no alternative or compensation was offered. Apply 24-hour cancellation rule for fresh purchases and Saver fare rules by days before departure. Fare-class non-refundable without qualifying disruption yields travel credit or denial.

steps.name: decide_ruling
steps.instruction: Issue the deterministic ruling: full refund to original payment for qualifying disruption; travel credit where only credit applies; deny otherwise. Refunds are not available if customer accepted alternative surface transport or after surrender window.

steps.name: issue_remedy
steps.instruction: After authorization, issue the refund to the original form of payment or the travel credit, and provide meal or hotel entitlements if the delay applies.

steps.name: Close-out (placeholder)
steps.instruction: After the customer is resolved: disposition of the item (restock / open-box / return to vendor / carrier claim) for retail; recovery within policy for airlines. Designed, not implemented, in the POC.

outcomes.remedy: full refund to original form of payment
outcomes.condition: Flight cancelled by airline or significantly delayed/changed, no alternative or compensation accepted, customer declines travel, refundable or qualifying fare

outcomes.remedy: future travel credit
outcomes.condition: Non-refundable fare cancelled with qualifying disruption but only credit applies (Main/Premium/Business/First fare)

outcomes.remedy: travel credit for 50% of ticket value and 100% of taxes
outcomes.condition: Saver fare cancelled 14 or more days before departure

outcomes.remedy: no refund
outcomes.condition: Saver fare cancelled 13 or fewer days before departure, or delay under 3 hours with customer travelling, or customer accepted alternative surface transport

outcomes.remedy: full refund to original form of payment
outcomes.condition: Booking cancelled within 24 hours of purchase

steps.name: verify_booking
steps.instruction: Look up the booking and confirm status, fare class, refundability, total paid, purchase time and whether the customer already travelled or cancelled.

steps.name: gather_requested_remedy
steps.instruction: Ask the customer whether they want a full refund or accept an alternative flight or travel credit, and record the requested remedy.

steps.name: check_flight_status
steps.instruction: Check the flight schedule change: measure the departure time change in minutes and whether the change is significant.

steps.name: check_refund_eligibility
steps.instruction: Evaluate whether an automatic or full refund applies: departure change over 120 minutes, or significant change with customer rejection of the new flight or alternative. Also apply the 24-hour cancellation window and the 12-month surrender limit.

steps.name: decide_ruling
steps.instruction: Rule approve/refund when the change exceeds 120 minutes or a significant change is rejected without accepted alternative; rule partial travel credit when the customer accepts a credit or non-refundable fare is eligible for future travel credit; otherwise deny. Refuse refund where alternative surface transport was accepted or the fare is an unused non-refundable Saver within the forfeiture window.

steps.name: act_issue_remedy
steps.instruction: After authorization, issue the refund to the original form of payment for approved full refunds, or issue a future travel credit for partial rulings. Credits do not convert to cash.

steps.name: Close-out (placeholder)
steps.instruction: After the customer is resolved: disposition of the item (restock / open-box / return to vendor / carrier claim) for retail; recovery within policy for airlines. Designed, not implemented, in the POC.

outcomes.remedy: Full refund to original form of payment
outcomes.condition: Departure time changed over 120 minutes, or significant change rejected with no accepted alternative, and booking refundable and within surrender window

outcomes.remedy: Future travel credit for the fare value; no cash refund
outcomes.condition: Significant change where non-refundable fare is eligible for future travel credit, or customer accepts a carrier credit

outcomes.remedy: No refund issued; explain policy basis to customer
outcomes.condition: Alternative surface transport or acceptable rebooking accepted, travel completed, or refund window passed
